conventions.deviation_tidewater_sphere: multi-scattering integrates a 64-point Fibonacci sphere instead of Tidewater's 8x8 theta/phi grid
conventions.deviation_tidewater_sub_uv: Tidewater's forward transmittance sub-UV uses W/(W+1) but its bake inverts with W/(W-1); we use the consistent Bruneton pair so lookups hit the baked texel centres
conventions.multiscatter_uv: u = cos(sun zenith) * 0.5 + 0.5, v = (r - R_ground)/(R_top - R_ground); row 0 is the ground
conventions.sub_uv: tex = 0.5/N + unit * (N-1)/N on both axes of both LUTs (Bruneton); inverse unit = (tex - 0.5/N) * N/(N-1)
conventions.transmittance_uv: u from the distance to the top d: (d - d_min)/(d_max - d_min); v = rho/H; row 0 (uv.y = 0) is the ground, column 0 is mu = 1 (zenith), the last column is the ground horizon

multiscatter.format: OpenEXR RGBA half, NO_COMPRESSION, scanline; RGB = Psi_ms, A = 1

transmittance.format: OpenEXR RGBA half, NO_COMPRESSION, scanline; RGB = transmittance to the top, A = 1

technique: Hillaire 2020 (EGSR) transmittance + multi-scattering LUTs; Bruneton 2008 transmittance mapping; ported from Tidewater (MIT, notice.code.tidewater)
units: km; LUT values are dimensionless transmittance and multi-scattering luminance per unit sun illuminance
